thread.title: Investment Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for September, 26th (AAPL, ABX, ALDX, AMZN, FNV, GOOG, IMG, ISR, SRPT)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Investment Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for September, 26th (AAPL, ABX, ALDX, AMZN, FNV, GOOG, IMG, ISR, SRPT)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Sep 26th, 2018 // No Comments
Investment Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Wednesday, September 26th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Cleveland Research. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Barrick Gold (TSE:ABX) (NYSE:ABX) had its sector perform rating reiterated by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada.
Aldeyra Therapeutics (NASDAQ:ALDX) had its positive rating reaffirmed by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. Canaccord Genuity currently has a $35.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $27.00.
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Macquarie.
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Morgan Stanley.
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its neutral rating reiterated by analysts at Morningstar, Inc..
Franco Nevada (TSE:FNV) (NYSE:FNV) had its neutral rating reissued by analysts at CSFB.
Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Morgan Stanley.
Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) had its neutral rating reaffirmed by analysts at Morningstar, Inc..
IAMGOLD (TSE:IMG) (NYSE:IAG) had its neutral rating reaffirmed by analysts at CSFB.
IsoRay (NYSEAMERICAN:ISR) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. They currently have a $1.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Our therapeutic models are patient-based, reflecting our assumptions for the market size, and share penetration rates and pricing. We use this to determine the future revenue streams. These metrics then flow into our valuation model.””
Sarepta Therapeutics (NASDAQ:SRPT) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. They currently have a $200.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $187.00.
